h1: How Zenia Boulevard transforms the relationship with its visitors through data and commercial intelligence
sub: Zenia Boulevard chooses Flame Analytics to better know its visitors, generate customer knowledge and improve the experience at one of the most important open-air shopping centers in Spain.

quote.text: Getting to know our visitors better lets us create more relevant experiences and establish a closer relationship with them.
quote.author: Marketing team

elCaso: Zenia Boulevard, one of the leading open-air shopping centers in Spain, has incorporated Flame Analytics as an intelligence platform to improve the relationship with its visitors and evolve its customer experience strategy.

With a wide range of retail, dining and leisure options, the center needed a more complete view of who its visitors are, how they interact with the space and how to turn every visit into an opportunity to generate knowledge.

Through Flame Analytics, Zenia Boulevard integrates analytics, connectivity and guest WiFi marketing to turn visitor interactions into useful information to improve the experience and optimize its commercial actions.

blocks.h2: From anonymous visitors to known customers

body.p: Today's shopping centers compete not only to attract visitors, but to build lasting relationships with them.
To achieve this, they need to better understand who visits the center, what interests they have and how they interact with the different commercial offerings.
Zenia Boulevard wanted to answer key questions:

list: How can we build our own customer database?
How can we improve communication with different user profiles?
How can we create more personalized experiences?
How can we increase loyalty and repeat visits?
How can we turn digital interactions into commercial knowledge?

body.quote: The goal was to evolve from a relationship based solely on the physical visit toward a model where every interaction provides useful information to improve the customer experience.

blocks.h2: A platform to know, connect and activate the visitor

body.p: Flame Analytics deployed a solution that combines digital services tied to WiFi connectivity with visitor-knowledge capabilities and data-driven marketing.
The platform lets Zenia Boulevard capture information from its visitors through a simple digital experience, generating its own database that helps it better understand its audience.
Thanks to this information, the center can:

list: Build a closer relationship with its customers.

body.p: The information obtained makes it possible to move from general campaigns to more personalized strategies, tailored to the interests and characteristics of each visitor.

body.h3: From visitor data to a more personalized experience

body.p: Connectivity stops being merely an added service and becomes a digital touchpoint capable of generating value.
Every interaction helps enrich customer knowledge and makes it possible to develop actions aimed at improving the overall experience within the shopping center.
This vision combines technology and commercial strategy to turn first-party data into a competitive advantage.
With Flame Analytics, Zenia Boulevard has new capabilities to better understand its audience and develop more relevant actions.
Teams can analyze the information generated by visitors and use it to improve marketing, communication and loyalty initiatives.
This intelligence supports decisions related to:

body.h3: From data capture to visitor intelligence

body.p: The project marks a step forward in Zenia Boulevard's digital transformation.
Incorporating first-party data lets the shopping center build a more direct relationship with its visitors and better understand their needs.

Thanks to Flame Analytics, Zenia Boulevard turns digital interactions into actionable knowledge, creating new opportunities to improve the experience, increase loyalty and optimize its commercial strategy.
